Virtualized Table ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Display a large dataset within a fixed viewport by rendering only visible rows.

Contract and composition ​

columns defines the rendered columns and data comes from the host. Set width and height to the actual viewport dimensions. See the full notes.

This entry point renders the public native virtualized table, forwards all native props, listeners, and slots, and forwards instance methods and live objects through its public ref. See the full notes.

Compose selection, editing, filtering, sorting, merges, and dynamic trees with renderers, slots, and host state. See the full notes.

To merge cells, read cells from the row slot and set the width and height on cloned VNodes. Keep the supplied cells intact. See the full notes.

scrollTo, scrollToLeft, scrollToTop, and scrollToRow are public scroll methods. See the full notes.

Composition and types ​

The first column's checkboxes use cellRenderer and host selection state. The complete renderers example shows select-all and its indeterminate state in the header. Build this behavior through renderers, since Table V2 has no built-in selection column registration like Table. See the full notes.

Native slots and type declarations ​

In the pinned 2.14.7 release, the #cell scope exposes rowData and column for reading the application value. The column.cellRenderer callback receives the computed cellData. This entry point preserves the distinct native types and forwarded parameters for both paths.

The native instance's $props type omits the onUpdate:expandedRowKeys listener key. The component emits update:expandedRowKeys at runtime. See the full notes.

Controlled sorting and overlays ​

The pinned release can emit an undefined order on the first sort event. Handle that value when controlling sorting. See the full notes.

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2BasicDemo' });
import { AsamAutoResizer, AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2Alignment } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
}
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<Row> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 180 },
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 100, align: AsamTableV2Alignment.RIGHT }
];
const rows: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index,
	name: '本地记录 ' + (index + 1),
	count: index + 1
}));
</script>

<style scoped>
.virtual-table-host {
	height: 240px;
	width: 100%;
}
</style>

Fixed sections, grouping, sorting, filtering, and state combinations ​

Example: layout-states

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<label>
			筛选名称
			<AsamInput v-model="query" />
		</label>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="empty">空数据</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="loading">显示覆盖层</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" @click="compact = !compact">
			调整容器宽度
		</AsamButton>
		<div :style="{ width: compact ? '480px' : '640px', height: '340px', maxWidth: '100%' }">
			<AsamAutoResizer>
				<template #default="{ width, height }">
					<AsamTableV2
						:columns="columns"
						:data="empty ? [] : displayed"
						:fixed-data="empty ? [] : [sticky]"
						:width="width"
						:height="height"
						:header-height="[30, 40]"
						:footer-height="36"
						:sort-state="sortState"
						:row-event-handlers="rowEvents"
						:row-class="rowClass"
						row-key="id"
						@column-sort="sort"
						@scroll="scroll = `${$event.scrollTop}:${$event.scrollLeft}`"
						@end-reached="endReached++"
					>
						<template #header="scope"><GroupHeader v-bind="scope" /></template>
						<template #footer>
							<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
								共 {{ displayed.length }} 行；滚动 {{ scroll }}；触底
								{{ endReached }}
								<span data-testid="v2-sort-source">
									最近排序请求 {{ lastSortRequest }}
								</span>
							</p>
						</template>
						<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">没有匹配的记录</p></template>
						<template v-if="loading" #overlay>
							<div class="ui030-loading-overlay" role="status">正在加载本地记录</div>
						</template>
					</AsamTableV2>
				</template>
			</AsamAutoResizer>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2LayoutStatesDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import type { FunctionalComponent } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamInput,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamAutoResizer,
	AsamTableV2,
	AsamTableV2FixedDir,
	AsamTableV2Placeholder,
	AsamTableV2SortOrder
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortState,
	AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
	detail: string;
}
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		count: 100 - id,
		detail: `记录 ${id + 1} 的完整说明`
	}))
);
const sticky: Row = { id: -1, name: '固定汇总行', count: 5050, detail: '始终位于表头下方' };
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称',
		width: 180,
		sortable: true,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT
	},
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 120, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 300 },
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '编号', width: 100, fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.RIGHT }
];
const query = ref('');
const empty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const hovered = ref(-2);
const scroll = ref('0:0');
const endReached = ref(0);
const sortState = ref<AsamTableV2SortState>({});
const lastSortRequest = ref('未触发');
const displayed = computed(() => rows.value.filter((row) => row.name.includes(query.value)));
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	lastSortRequest.value = `${String(key)}:${String(order)}`;
	// Native 2.14.7 can emit undefined for a column absent from controlled sortState.
	const nextOrder = order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC;
	sortState.value = { [key]: nextOrder };
	rows.value.sort((a, b) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? a.count - b.count
				: a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return nextOrder === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
}
const rowEvents: AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers = {
	onMouseenter: ({ rowIndex }) => {
		hovered.value = rowIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hovered.value = -2;
	}
};
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex === hovered.value ? 'ui030-hovered' : rowIndex % 2 ? 'ui030-striped' : '';
const GroupHeader: FunctionalComponent<AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam> = ({
	cells,
	columns: current,
	headerIndex
}) => {
	if (headerIndex === 1) return cells;
	return current.map((column, index) =>
		column.placeholderSign === AsamTableV2Placeholder
			? cells[index]
			: h(
					'div',
					{ class: 'el-table-v2__header-cell', style: { width: `${column.width}px` } },
					column.fixed ? '固定区' : '记录信息'
				)
	);
};
</script>
<style>
.ui030-loading-overlay {
	height: 100%;
	display: grid;
	place-items: center;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	opacity: 0.9;
}

.ui030-hovered {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary-hover);
}

.ui030-striped {
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-root-layout {
	display: flex;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
}
.demo-root-layout > :is(p, pre, output) {
	margin-block: 0;
}
</style>

	margin-block: 16px;

	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Selection and inline editing (multiple files) ​

Example: renderers

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			选中 {{ rows.filter((row) => row.checked).length }} 行；首行 {{ rows[0].name }}
		</p>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
			type="primary"
			@click="table?.scrollToRow(rows.length - 1, 'end')"
		>
			查看最后一行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="table?.scrollToRow(0, 'start')">
			返回首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTableV2
			ref="table"
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows"
			:width="640"
			:height="260"
			row-key="id"
			:row-height="44"
			:scrollbar-always-on="true"
		/>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2RenderersDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2FixedDir } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2Expose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SelectionCell from './SelectionCell.vue';
import EditorCell from './EditorCell.vue';
import type { Row } from './Row.js';
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		checked: false,
		editing: false
	}))
);
const table = ref<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const drafts = new Map<number, string>();
const columns = computed<AsamTableV2Columns<unknown>>(() => [
	{
		key: 'selection',
		width: 60,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT,
		headerCellRenderer: () =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: '选择所有记录',
				checked: rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				indeterminate:
					rows.value.some((row) => row.checked) &&
					!rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				onChange: (checked: boolean) =>
					rows.value.forEach((row) => {
						row.checked = checked;
					})
			}),
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: `选择记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				checked: rowData.checked,
				onChange: (checked: boolean) => {
					rowData.checked = checked;
				}
			})
	},
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称（点击编辑）',
		width: 360,
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(EditorCell, {
				label: `编辑记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				value: rowData.name,
				editing: rowData.editing,
				onStart: () => {
					drafts.set(rowData.id, rowData.name);
					rowData.editing = true;
				},
				onChange: (value: string) => {
					rowData.name = value;
				},
				onFinish: () => {
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				},
				onCancel: () => {
					rowData.name = drafts.get(rowData.id) ?? rowData.name;
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				}
			})
	},
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '稳定行键', width: 140 }
]);
</script>

Row and column hover ​

cellProps attaches host mouseenter and mouseleave handlers and row and column identifiers to each cell. The host tracks the current row and column and uses an ASAM token to highlight the full visible row and all visible cells in that column. Leaving the cell clears the highlight. The layout-states demo shows row-only hover. Both examples preserve virtual scrolling and selection behavior.

Example: cross-hovering

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			{{
				hoveredRow < 0
					? '未悬停'
					: `悬停第 ${hoveredRow + 1} 行、第 ${hoveredColumn + 1} 列`
			}}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows"
			:cell-props="cellProps"
			:width="600"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2CrossHoveringDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<string> = ['名称', '所属组', '说明'].map((title, index) => ({
	key: `value${index}`,
	dataKey: `value${index}`,
	title,
	width: 200
}));
const rows = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	value0: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	value1: `组 ${Math.floor(id / 5) + 1}`,
	value2: `说明 ${id + 1}`
}));
const hoveredRow = ref(-1);
const hoveredColumn = ref(-1);
const cellProps: AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter<string> = ({ columnIndex, rowIndex }) => ({
	'data-column': columnIndex,
	'data-record': rowIndex,
	style: {
		backgroundColor:
			columnIndex === hoveredColumn.value || rowIndex === hoveredRow.value
				? 'var(--asam-color-primary-hover)'
				: undefined
	},
	onMouseenter: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = rowIndex;
		hoveredColumn.value = columnIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = -1;
		hoveredColumn.value = -1;
	}
});
</script>

Controlled single-column sorting with sortBy ​

sortBy holds a single { key, order }. The column-sort handler writes back the object, and a host computed value sorts a copy of the data. See the full notes.

Example: sort-by

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			单列排序 {{ sortBy.key }}:{{ sortBy.order }}；首行 {{ displayed[0]?.name }}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="displayed"
			:sort-by="sortBy"
			:width="500"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
			@column-sort="sort"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SortByDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2SortOrder } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortBy
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 300, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 200, sortable: true }
];
const rows = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	count: 12 - id
}));
const sortBy = ref<AsamTableV2SortBy>({ key: 'count', order: AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC });
const displayed = computed(() => {
	const { key, order } = sortBy.value;
	return [...rows].sort((left, right) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? left.count - right.count
				: left.name.localeCompare(right.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return order === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
});
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	// The host owns both the single-column descriptor and the displayed data.
	sortBy.value = { key, order: order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC };
}
</script>

Sticky groups that change on scroll ​

The example saves scrollTop from the scroll event in host state. It derives the current group from the explicit rowHeight and group record counts and uses a computed value to update fixedData. See the full notes.

Example: sticky-scroll

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="ui037-sticky-scroll">
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" @click="table?.scrollToTop(480)">
			定位第三组
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="table?.scrollToTop(0)">
			返回首组
		</AsamButton>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			当前吸顶 {{ fixedData[0]?.name }}；滚动 {{ scrollTop }}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			ref="table"
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows.slice(1)"
			:fixed-data="fixedData"
			:row-height="rowHeight"
			:row-class="rowClass"
			:width="600"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
			@scroll="onScroll"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2StickyScrollDemo' });
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2Expose,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 220 },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 380 }
];
const groupLength = 6;
const rowHeight = 40;
const rows = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: id % groupLength === 0 ? `第 ${id / groupLength + 1} 组` : `记录 ${id}`,
	detail: id % groupLength === 0 ? '滚动到下一组时替换此吸顶记录' : '普通记录'
}));
const table = shallowRef<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const scrollTop = ref(0);
const fixedData = computed(() => {
	const groupIndex = Math.min(
		Math.floor(scrollTop.value / (rowHeight * groupLength)),
		rows.length / groupLength - 1
	);
	return rows.slice(groupIndex * groupLength, groupIndex * groupLength + 1);
});
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex < 0 ? 'ui037-active-sticky' : '';
function onScroll({ scrollTop: next }: { scrollTop: number }): void {
	scrollTop.value = next;
}
</script>

	font-weight: 600;

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2HeaderFilterDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import HeaderFilter from './HeaderFilter.vue';

const completedOnly = ref(false);

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SpansDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import RowRenderer from './RowRenderer.vue';
const merge = ref(true);
const mode = ref<'row' | 'column' | 'both'>('both');
const cellProps: AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }) => ({
	'data-merged':
		merge.value && rowIndex % 2 === 0 && columnIndex === 0
			? mode.value === 'both'
				? '2x2'
				: mode.value === 'row'
					? '2x1'
					: '1x2'
			: undefined
});
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = ['name', 'group', 'count', 'note'].map(
	(key, index) => ({
		key,
		dataKey: key,
		title: ['姓名', '分组', '数量', '备注'][index] ?? key,
		width: 140
	})
);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `合并记录 ${id + 1}`,
	group: `分组 ${Math.floor(id / 2)}`,
	count: id,
	note: '独立未合并列'
}));
</script>
vue
<template><RenderCells /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { cloneVNode } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	cells: VNode[];
	rowIndex: number;
	merge: boolean;
	mode: 'row' | 'column' | 'both';
}>();
const RenderCells = () => {
	const cells = [...props.cells];
	if (!props.merge) return cells;
	const mergeRow = props.mode !== 'column';
	const mergeColumn = props.mode !== 'row';
	if (!mergeRow || props.rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], {
			style: {
				width: mergeColumn ? '280px' : '140px',
				height: mergeRow ? '87px' : '44px',
				alignSelf: 'flex-start',
				zIndex: 1,
				background: 'var(--asam-color-surface)',
				border: '1px solid var(--asam-color-border)'
			},
			'data-merged': '2x2'
		});
		if (mergeColumn) cells.splice(1, 1);
	} else {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
		if (mergeColumn) cells[1] = cloneVNode(cells[1], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
	}
	return cells;
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2TreeDynamicDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import TreeCell from './TreeCell.vue';
import DetailRow from './DetailRow.vue';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	detail?: string;
	children?: Row[];
}
const rows = ref([
	{ id: 1, name: '父记录', children: [{ id: 2, name: '子记录', detail: '短详情。' }] },
	...Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index + 10,
		name: `普通记录 ${index + 1}`,
		children: [] as Row[]
	}))
]);
const expanded = ref<number[]>([]);
// 2.14.7 measures variable rows on mount. Rebuild its height cache after content changes;
// the host retains both the tree data and controlled expansion keys.
const heightRevision = ref(0);
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '动态树与详情',
		width: 470,
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(TreeCell, { name: rowData.name, detail: rowData.detail })
	},
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: 'ID', width: 100 }
];
function changeHeight(): void {
	const child = rows.value[0].children[0];
	child.detail = (child.detail?.length ?? 0) > 20 ? '短详情。' : '动态高度详情。'.repeat(30);
	heightRevision.value += 1;
}
function appendChild(): void {
	rows.value[0].children.push({ id: Date.now(), name: '新子记录', detail: '追加后仍保持展开。' });
	expanded.value = [1];
}
</script>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Instance, types, and boundaries ​

The public API and complete SFCs on this page use the same component entry point. The TS and JS demos each include all local dependencies. Type constraints appear in the TS versions. The host handles remote requests and application persistence.

Usage and contract notes ​

Contract and composition ​

columns defines the rendered columns and data comes from the host. Set width and height to the actual viewport dimensions. Use AsamAutoResizer to observe a parent with an explicit height. Set rowHeight for fixed rows and estimatedRowHeight for dynamic rows. Version 2.14.7 measures the actual height when a row mounts. When detail content changes length, the example updates its key to rebuild the height cache, and the host retains its data and expanded keys. size accepts large, big, default, and small. Omitting it inherits the nearest ASAM size scope. It applies brand styling. Native defaults and explicit rowHeight and headerHeight values stay in effect, and the host supplies actual viewport constraints.

Contract and composition ​

This entry point renders the public native virtualized table, forwards all native props, listeners, and slots, and forwards instance methods and live objects through its public ref. ASAM adds the asam-table-v2 class and data-asam-size through the public interface and leaves native setup, returned VNodes, and caching to the underlying table. Native defaults and validation handle omitted values and explicit undefined, null, and false.

Contract and composition ​

Compose selection, editing, filtering, sorting, merges, and dynamic trees with renderers, slots, and host state. The selection example provides select-all, an indeterminate header, and per-row selection. Editing supports entering edit mode, typing, committing with Enter or blur, and canceling with Escape. The editing cell lives in a separate file. Combine fixed columns, fixed summary rows, grouped headers, controlled sorting, host filtering, row states and hover, and footer, empty, and overlay with the same entry point.

Contract and composition ​

To merge cells, read cells from the row slot and set the width and height on cloned VNodes. Keep the supplied cells intact. Merge contiguous rows and avoid spans that cross the virtual viewport boundary, where some content may be hidden. The example preserves the other columns. Provide children and a stable rowKey for tree data, and use expandedRowKeys and expandColumnKey to control expansion. The host updates the tree for dynamic details and appended nodes.

Contract and composition ​

scrollTo, scrollToLeft, scrollToTop, and scrollToRow are public scroll methods. The instance example reaches the last row and returns to the start. column-sort, expanded-rows-change, row-expand, rows-rendered, scroll, and end-reached report state for composition. Apply sorting and filtering to host data and keep incoming data intact in computed values.

Composition and types ​

The first column's checkboxes use cellRenderer and host selection state. The complete renderers example shows select-all and its indeterminate state in the header. Table V2 has no automatic selection column registration. Its public renderers and slots work with host state to implement selection, editing, merges, and filtering, as shown in the multi-file examples on this page. Named AsamTableV2 aliases in this entry point's Types.ts cover native column, row, cell, header, sort, and event callback types. ENG-006 supplies the generated root exports. Use each callback's own contract to distinguish the application row type from the cell value type.

Native slots and type declarations ​

The native instance's $props type omits the onUpdate:expandedRowKeys listener key. The component emits update:expandedRowKeys at runtime. The full TS example uses v-model:expanded-row-keys in its template. Verify template typing and actual updates with the consuming project's compiler configuration and runtime.

Controlled single-column sorting with sortBy ​

sortBy holds a single { key, order }. The column-sort handler writes back the object, and a host computed value sorts a copy of the data. Clicking the same column flips direction. Switching columns replaces the sort key. In 2.14.7, switching columns also flips direction based on the current sortBy.order, so the host uses the emitted order. The layout-states example also shows controlled sorting with a per-column sortState map.

Sticky groups that change on scroll ​

The example saves scrollTop from the scroll event in host state. It derives the current group from the explicit rowHeight and group record counts and uses a computed value to update fixedData. Ordinary scrolling, calling the public scrollToTop to reach the third group, and returning to the first group all drive the same transition. The layout-states example demonstrates a fixed summary row. With dynamic row heights, choose a group-positioning strategy suited to the host data.

Filtering with a header renderer (multiple files) ​

The status column's headerCellRenderer renders a local HeaderFilter SFC. Its header button opens a native dialog. Confirm writes the draft selection to the host, Cancel preserves the current filter, and Reset restores all records. A host computed value updates the displayed data. The dialog opens in the browser's top layer. The host owns this filter and the example uses its own dialog. Both TS and JS variants include the entry and helper files.

Additional props and events ​

Controlled sorting and overlays ​

In 2.14.7, if sortState has no entry for the clicked column, the first column-sort event may report an undefined order. The sorting contract preserves that case in ColumnSortParams, ColumnSortHandler, Props / PropsPublic, the Expose / Instance $props, and the actual component listener. The layout-states example starts with ASC when the initial order is missing and then stores a valid order. Later clicks switch between ascending and descending. Use <template v-if="loading" #overlay> to conditionally provide the overlay slot itself. Hiding only its contents leaves an empty overlay that intercepts clicks.
